item.title: Digital Twin for Data‑Driven Development of Industrial Robots (Isaac Sim + ROS 2)
item.description:
Abstract

This article presents an industrial digital twin that integrates two 6‑DoF industrial manipulators, grippers, multi‑modal vision, and force‑torque sensing with NVIDIA Isaac Sim via ROS 2. The platform enables virtual commissioning, teleoperation, perception benchmarking, and GPU‑accelerated, collision‑free trajectory generation that is consistent across simulation and physical execution. Empirical results demonstrate real‑time capabilities (∼100 Hz control, 30 FPS stereo perception, and ∼30 FPS simulation), and show reliable sim‑to‑real transfer for object pose estimation using synthetic data generated in Isaac Sim. 1
